sources.title: WellSky salaries: How much does WellSky pay? | Indeed.com
sources.snippet: # WellSky salaries: How much does WellSky pay? ## Average Salaries at WellSky. ## Common questions about salaries at WellSky. Do people feel that they are paid fairly for their work at WellSky? Indeed’s Work Happiness survey asked over 66 current and former employees whether they feel they are paid fairly for their work. Learn more about how happy people feel at WellSky. Do you receive overtime pay for your role at WellSky? Indeed’s survey asked 16 current and former employees whether they receive overtime pay for their role at WellSky. Of the respondents, 19% said that they receive overtime pay. How often do you get pay raises at WellSky? Indeed’s survey asked over 27 current and former employees how often they received pay raises when they worked at WellSky. Most respondents said they got a raise annually. Learn more about professional development at WellSky. Do you get paid sick days at WellSky? Indeed’s survey asked over 36 current and former employees how many paid sick days they received for their role. When asked if their paid sick days reset each year, 90% of respondents said that they did. Learn more about paid time off, parental leave and work-life balance at WellSky. Do you get paid time off at WellSky? Indeed’s survey asked over 36 current and former employees how many paid vacation days they received for their role. Learn more about paid time off, parental leave and work-life balance at WellSky. How much vacation and PTO did you get at WellSky? We asked over 36 current and former employees how many paid vacation days they received for their role. When asked about how much of their paid time off people actually used, respondents said 6-9 days. 24 current and former employees responded to a question about how many paid personal days they received for their role at WellSky. Respondents said they received no paid personal days. Learn more about paid time off, parental leave and work-life balance at WellSky. ## Browse all WellSky salaries by category. The average WellSky salary ranges from approximately $41,952 per year for Business Development Representative to $178,279 per year for DevOps Engineer.
